set_value.name: $SESMiningOverrideNow
set_value.exact: (@global.$SES_Wreck_Mining_Beta_Enabled and @global.$SES_Turret_Salvage_Ships.{this.ship} and this.ship == player.controlled) or (@global.$SES_Wreck_Mining_Beta_Enabled and this.ship != player.controlled and @global.$SES_Salvage_Active.{this.ship}.exists)

set_value.name: $SESMiningWreck
set_value.exact: if this.ship == player.controlled then @player.target else null

do_if.value: (@$SESMiningWreck.iswreck or (@global.$SES_Salvage_Standins.{$SESMiningWreck} and @$SESMiningWreck.isoperational)) and ($SESMiningWreck.isrealclass.ship_s or $SESMiningWreck.isrealclass.ship_m) and @$SESMiningWreck.sector == this.sector

not @$SESMiningWreck.tugship and not @$SESMiningWreck.dismantlingobject and not @$SESMiningWreck.salvageclaimants.count and not @global.$SES_Wreck_Harvest_State.{$SESMiningWreck}.$exhausted and this.ship.distanceto.{$SESMiningWreck} le this.ship.maxcombatrange.{weaponmode.mining}.turrets

debug_text.text: '[SES][TURRET BETA] Selected wreck targeting. ship=%s target=%s eligible=%s'.[this.ship, $SESMiningWreck, $miningtargets.count]

'[SES][TURRET BETA] DISPATCH gates. pilot=%s occupied=%s playerowned=%s miningmode=%s attackable=%s'.[this.ship.assignedpilot, this.ship == player.occupiedship, this.isplayerowned, $turretmodes.indexof.{weaponmode.mining}, @$SESMiningWreck.canbeattacked]

do_if.value: @global.$SES_Wreck_Mining_Beta_Enabled and @global.$SES_Turret_Salvage_Ships.{this.ship} and this.ship == player.controlled and @global.$SES_Debug_Log_Chance and @$SESMiningDispatchSamples lt 3

debug_text.text: '[SES][TURRET BETA] DISPATCH reached. ship=%s target=%s candidates=%s pilot=%s occupied=%s attackable=%s actualtargets=%s'.[this.ship, @player.target, $miningtargets.count, this.ship.assignedpilot, this.ship == player.occupiedship, @player.target.canbeattacked, $miningtargets.list]

'[SES][TURRET BETA] FIRING CHECK turret=%s mode=%s ready=%s range=%s targetdistance=%s'.[$SESDiagnosticTurret, $SESDiagnosticTurret.mode, $SESDiagnosticTurret.isreadytofire, $SESDiagnosticTurret.maxfirerange, if @player.target.exists then $SESDiagnosticTurret.distanceto.{player.target} else -1m]
